user_review.method: Maintainer review from public description and isolated synthetic fixtures or explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs. Not independent review, external user research, or production usage.

scenarios.request: Approve one tracked removal and one untracked quarantine; keep unverified parser.
scenarios.expected: Exactly approved actions occur; no full-close claim.
scenarios.observed: Old example approved 10 candidates but described 11 actions; new table yields one removal, one quarantine, one retained file. Walkthrough ends shed-only after checks.

scenarios.request: Tests fail, or another worker has uncommitted changes in the target path.
scenarios.observed: Instruction walkthrough stops before destructive action; README states failure/ownership blocker and distinguishes absent tests. No actual production cleanup, upload, cold-reader test or tagging performed.

similar_skills.learned: Incident facts, contributing factors, implemented fixes and verification remain distinct.
similar_skills.reason: Preserve reported facts and uncertainty; do not import automatic global-skill edits or require a fixed five-whys structure for one small incident.

similar_skills.learned: A compact handoff names goal, state, validation and next actions and references existing artifacts.
similar_skills.reason: Use explicit evidence and next action; temporary storage and AI handoff scope are not appropriate for every workflow.

validation.observed: Product page and manifest audit returned VERDICT: PASS; source/metadata identities retained.

decision: Replaced inconsistent numeric narrative with an auditable approval/action table and shed-only recovery. Metadata already aligned; retained.
